events.summary:
SVRLMK

The National Weather Service in Louisville has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
East central Green County in central Kentucky...
Southern Marion County in central Kentucky...
Taylor County in central Kentucky...
West central Casey County in central Kentucky...
Northeastern Adair County in south central Kentucky...

* Until 530 PM EDT/430 PM CDT/.

* At 446 PM EDT/346 PM CDT/, severe thunderstorms were located along
a line extending from 11 miles west of Lebanon to near
Campbellsville to Greensburg, moving east at 25 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Campbellsville, Greensburg, Bradfordsville, Absher, Arista, South
Campbellsville, Romine, Calvary, Mannsville, Wooleyville, White
Rose, Acton, Hatcher, Taylor County Airport, Bluff Boom,
Jessietown, Merrimac, Casey Creek, Hobson, and Cane Valley.

* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...West Central Baldwin County in southwestern Alabama...

* WHEN...Until 515 PM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Water over roadways.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 322 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain have
fallen.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Daphne, Spanish Fort, Robertsdale, Loxley, Stapleton, Silverhill,
Malbis, Belforest, Steelwood, Pine Haven, Bridgehead, Rosinton,
Montrose and Bromley.
